an10.220:1.1: Atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
an10.220:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an10.220:1.3: ‘ko nu kho bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo, yena-m-idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantī' ti?
an10.220:1.4: ‘Adhammacariyāvisamacariyāhetu kho brāhmaṇa evam idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantī' ti.
an10.220:2.1: ‘Ko pana bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo, yena-m-idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī' ti?
an10.220:2.2: ‘Dhammacariyāsamacariyāhetu kho brāhmaṇa evam idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī' ti.
an10.220:3.1: ‘Na kho ahaṃ imassa bhoto Gotamassa saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi,
an10.220:3.2: sādhu me bhavaṃ Gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu, yathāhaṃ imassa bhoto Gotamassa saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājāneyyan' ti.
an10.220:3.3: ‘Tena hi brāhmaṇa suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmī' ti.
an10.220:3.4: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho so brāhmaṇo Bhagavato paccassosi.
an10.220:4.1: Tividhā kho brāhmaṇa kāyena adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti,
an10.220:5.1: Kathañ ca brāhmaṇa tividhā kāyena adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti? . . . pe . . .
an10.220:5.2: Evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa tividhā kāyena adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti.
an10.220:6.1: Kathañ ca brāhmaṇa catubbidhā vācāya adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti? . . . pe . . .
an10.220:6.2: Evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa catubbidhā vācāya adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti.
an10.220:7.1: Kathañ ca brāhmaṇa tividhā manasā adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti? . . . pe . . .
an10.220:7.2: Evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa tividhā manasā adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti.
